assumes.label: Weak-field low-velocity limit
assumes.description: The regime where gravitational fields are weak and velocities are much smaller than the speed of light, so spacetime curvature can be treated as a small perturbation on flat space.

attrs.description: Relate the curvature of spacetime directly to the energy and momentum of whatever matter and radiation are present, forming the core field equation of general relativity.
conditions: Valid in any smooth Lorentzian spacetime manifold
Assumes a classical (non-quantum) description of matter and gravity

representations.name: Component form for a specific metric, e.g. Schwarzschild or FLRW
